calculation.formula: IF SUM(IF [event_type]="Click" THEN [event_count] END) / IIF(SUM(IF [event_type]="Send" THEN [event_count] END) = 0, NULL, SUM(IF [event_type]="Send" THEN [event_count] END)) >= 0.03 THEN "Green" ELSEIF SUM(IF [event_type]="Click" THEN [event_count] END) / IIF(SUM(IF [event_type]="Send" THEN [event_count] END) = 0, NULL, SUM(IF [event_type]="Send" THEN [event_count] END)) >= 0.01 THEN "Amber" ELSE "Red" END
